story.title: Free & Fun Events in Arlington: November 19 - 25, 2026
story.summary: Stay informed with this twice-weekly e-newsletter sent right to your inbox. Enjoy these free and fun events scheduled across The American Dream City from November 19-25, 2026. Check back each week for a new list of family-friendly activities! Texas Authors Book Club: “The Raven: A Biography of Sam Houston” by Marquis James Explore Texas history through literature at the Texas Authors Book Club on Thursday, Nov. 19, at 6:30 p.m. at Fielder Museum , 1616 W. Abram St. This month’s discussion features The Raven: A Biography of Sam Houston by Marquis James, winner of the 1930 Pulitzer Prize for Nonfiction. The book offers a sweeping look at Sam Houston’s extraordinary life and the turbulent, ambitious spirit of 19th-century America.
